description: This source file implements functions and classes for parsing and handling Widevine DRM headers (WRM headers) in a Windows environment, including parsing initialization data, extracting key IDs, and creating content header streams.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: A helper class for reading data from a byte buffer, supporting reading GUIDs, big-endian and little-endian integers, and skipping bytes.

classes.name: WrmHeader
classes.description: A class representing a Widevine DRM header, capable of parsing initialization data to extract the WRM header and key ID, and creating content header streams.

methods.name: ParseWrmHeaderFromInitializationData
methods.description: Parses the initialization data to extract the WRM header bytes associated with PlayReady DRM.

methods.name: ParseKeyIdFromWrmHeader
methods.description: Extracts the key ID GUID from the WRM header XML data.

methods.name: CreateWrmHeaderStream
methods.description: Creates an IStream object from the WRM header bytes.

methods.name: CreateContentHeaderFromWrmHeader
methods.description: Creates a content header stream from the WRM header bytes, formatted for use with PlayReady DRM.

methods.name: ResetStreamPosition
methods.description: Resets the position of an IStream to the beginning.
